uncited: **Inputs:** A sparse set of uncalibrated images (typically 3–10 views).
**Outputs:** A set of 3D Gaussian primitives (position, covariance, opacity, spherical harmonics coefficients) optimized for novel view synthesis.

*   Covariance matrix $\boldsymbol{\Sigma}_i \in \mathbb{R}^{3 \times 3}$, parameterized by a rotation matrix $\mathbf{R}_i$ and scaling vector $\mathbf{s}_i$ such that $\boldsymbol{\Sigma}_i = \mathbf{R}_i \mathbf{S}_i \mathbf{S}_i^T \mathbf{R}_i^T$.
*   Spherical Harmonics (SH) coefficients $\mathbf{c}_{i, l}$ for color $c$.
**Geometry Priors:** Depth maps and/or point clouds generated by MASt3R or VGGT from the input image pairs.
**Gaussian Initialization:** Initialize the mean positions $\boldsymbol{\mu}_i$ of the Gaussians from the generated point cloud.
The optimization is significantly faster than standard 3DGS due to the high-quality initialization from priors.
*   **Degenerate Input:** If priors are noisy or missing, initialization may fail.
A module that enhances existing feed-forward models by merging and refining Gaussian primitives in a canonical 3D space using a hybrid Splat-Voxel representation.
InstantSplat was introduced as a solution to the bottleneck of Structure-from-Motion (SfM) in 3D Gaussian Splatting.
